boxes.observation: Complete baseline with cotés/côtés, mutuellement, non adjacents, a stop and closing parenthesis. The ending of mutuellement is compressed to a long low run and terminal crossing stroke.

boxes.observation: Two heading baselines, each with a long underline, followed on the second baseline by Décomposition en. The first underline starts beneath the interior of the initial word; the second also begins inside the word rather than at its first letter.
uncertainties: Final s versus terminal pen flourish remains unresolved in the three heading words; plural readings are listed first.

The raised character is read xi first; a sigma-shaped alternative remains supported by its three broad strokes.
